calculation.description: For each tradable asset, divide the trailing 20-session return by the 30-session root-mean-square of negative daily returns. Multiply the cross-section by a persistent breadth state: +1 when at least 65% of available assets have positive 20-session returns, -1 when at most 35% are positive, and otherwise retain the previous state. All inputs are lagged to the prior completed session.

validation.regime_notes: Positive aggregate 10d IC in 2028, 2029, 2031 and 2032; negative in 2026, 2027 and 2033 YTD. The small average cross-section and 2033 weakness require conservative monitoring.
